coordinate_system: Existing frontend world gauge; no3D reference/metric calibration

roughness.sampling: Independent area-uniform barycentric surface points, not mesh vertices; count targets area/spacing^2, capped explicitly
roughness.plane: Least-squares PCA plane over support neighbors excluding independent query; query distance and sqrt smallest covariance eigenvalue
roughness.interpretation: Fixed spatial scale lowers tessellation bias. Includes real curvature, nearby sheets and noise; not true3D distance error. Same-normal filter excludes opposite sides/steep folds but may exclude valid fold detail.
roughness.comparability: Radius/diagonal fixed; sampling density changes when capped; report actual spacing/valid fraction. Different mesh areas are not identical anatomical regions.

boundary.definition: Only all-degree2 simple-cycle components count as unambiguous boundary loops. Branched networks retain cycle-rank separately; loops are not automatically holes.
boundary.leaf_edge_policy: Visible foreground-mask boundary support is a leaf/foreground-edge candidate; RAP also includes pot/marker. Internal missing projection is a separate proxy. Neither labels physical3D holes.
boundary.area_policy: Boundary polygon best-fit projected area is not a hole area; outer leaf perimeters also enclose polygons.
boundary.visibility_policy: Boundary point camera Z agrees within max(diagonal/1024,0.2% depth) with finite first-hit depth in3x3 image neighborhood; occluded points are excluded
